actions.action: Repot into a pot only one size larger (2-5 cm wider) in spring or early summer
Use a chunky, well-draining mix (potting soil with perlite, orchid bark, or coco chips)
Optionally divide the multiple stems into separate plants when repotting
If any roots are black, mushy, or smelly, trim them off
